candidates.name: provision_workforce_workspace_membership
candidates.rerunSafeBasis: CREATE OR REPLACE function, trigger recreated, inserts use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; the repair call is idempotent.
candidates.notes: requestWorkspace requires an active portal_organization_membership row. The prior Auth trigger created a profile without that membership, so this must be applied before the handlers deploy or affected workforce identities receive 403. The migration calls portal_repair_workforce_workspace_memberships() itself and fails closed when the active Internal organization is absent.

ordering: Apply candidates 1 through 5 in listed order before deploying any handler that imports _shared/request-workspace.ts.
Candidate 5 must precede handler deployment so existing workforce identities retain an active Internal membership.

Candidates 2 and 3 must both be applied before any handler deployment; storeCommand and resolveStoreContext fail closed (503/403) when their functions are absent, which degrades Store paths rather than opening them.
Internal and Brand request paths return before resolveStoreContext is reached, so they are unaffected by candidate 2 and 3 timing.
prohibited: supabase db push against production or the staging project
replaying historical repository migrations against the staging schema-only baseline
applying candidate 2, 3 or 4 twice without an explicit repair review
enabling Store access or releasing the Store ordering hold as part of applying this list
